question:
**Direction: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Curious
solution:
The correct answer is "Uninterested."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Curious" means wanting to know or learn something. (कुछ जानने या सीखने का इच्‍छुक; उत्‍सुक, जिज्ञासु)

 
 
• Example:* He was **curious**__ to know how the machine worked.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word is **"Uninterested."**
 
• "Uninterested" means having or showing no feeling of interest; indifferent. (रुचि की भावना न होना या प्रदर्शित होना; उदासीन)
 __
 
• Example: *He's completely **uninterested**__ in sports.*
 
 
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Passionate: **showing or caused by very strong feelings. (भावावेशपूर्ण)
 
• **Complex: **made up of several connected parts and often difficult to understand; complicated. (अनेक परस्‍पर संबद्घ अंशों से निर्मित और प्रायः दुर्बोध; पेचीदा; जटिल)
 
• **Doubtful: **unlikely or uncertain. (संदिग्‍ध या अनिश्चित)
